description: Free-first starter choices for the chat model selector. First-time users see instant Supergenious chat and local model setup. Browser-model experiments, internal helpers and broad model catalogs stay advanced.

models.label: Supergenious
models.best_for: Immediate useful answers for first-time visitors without installing a node or relying on browser WebGPU.
models.install_note: No setup required. Local/private nodes can take over after they are connected and verified live.
models.commercial_use: MMIR hosted free route; verify production terms before resale

models.label: MMIR Guide - free browser helper
models.best_for: Immediate onboarding, explaining MMIR, choosing a free local model and helping the user connect a backend.
models.install_note: No install required. This is a deterministic browser helper, not a full LLM.

models.label: MMIR Model Picker - live helper
models.best_for: Choosing the right free model, install route and capacity path.
models.install_note: No install required. Deterministic model-selection helper.

models.label: MMIR Setup Coach - live helper
models.best_for: Getting from first visit to local model running.
models.install_note: No install required. Deterministic setup helper.

models.label: MMIR Security Coach - live helper
models.best_for: Explaining local-first, secrets, provider keys and zero-trust choices.
models.install_note: No install required. Deterministic security helper.

models.label: MMIR Growth Coach - live helper
models.best_for: Freemium, marketplace and premium feature guidance.
models.install_note: No install required. Deterministic growth helper.

models.label: Qwen Browser - experimental
models.best_for: Fastest real browser LLM test without backend or API key on supported devices.
models.install_note: Experimental. Runs locally only when this browser supports WebGPU/WASM; first message downloads model weights and may take time.

models.label: Gemma Browser - experimental
models.best_for: Useful small browser assistant when WebGPU is available.
models.install_note: Experimental. Runs locally only when this browser supports WebGPU/WASM; first message downloads model weights and may take time.

models.label: Llama Browser - experimental
models.best_for: Personal assistant-style browser chat without backend setup.
models.install_note: Experimental. Runs locally only when this browser supports WebGPU/WASM; first message downloads model weights and may take time.

models.label: Phi Browser - experimental
models.best_for: Compact reasoning/chat in browser on capable machines.
models.install_note: Experimental. Runs locally only when this browser supports WebGPU/WASM; this is heavier than the 0.5B/1B starters.

models.label: SmolLM2 135M - tiny free local
models.best_for: Fastest first local smoke test on weak machines.
models.install_note: Small model for proving the local loop works; quality is limited.

models.label: Gemma 3 270M - tiny free local
models.best_for: Light local chat and onboarding on constrained hardware.
models.install_note: Good first model when the user wants a very small download.

models.label: Qwen2.5 0.5B - small multilingual
models.best_for: Small multilingual and coding-adjacent tests.
models.install_note: Useful when the user wants a small model with broad language coverage.

models.label: Qwen3 0.6B - tiny reasoning local
models.best_for: Small reasoning, multilingual and agent-style local tests.
models.install_note: Use when the user wants a very small reasoning-capable local model.

models.label: Gemma 3 1B - balanced free local
models.best_for: Better first assistant quality while still staying small.
models.install_note: Good default starter when bandwidth and RAM allow a slightly larger model.

models.label: Llama 3.2 1B - local assistant
models.best_for: Personal assistant, summarization and local edge tests.
models.install_note: Stronger starter option for users with a normal laptop/desktop.

models.label: TinyLlama 1.1B - tiny local chat
models.best_for: Fast local smoke tests and lightweight offline chat on weak machines.
models.install_note: Good fallback when downloads and memory must stay very small; answer quality is limited.

models.label: DeepSeek-R1 1.5B - reasoning local
models.best_for: Reasoning-style local tests and technical prompts.
models.install_note: Use when reasoning behavior matters more than speed.

models.label: Granite 3.3 2B - long-context business local
models.best_for: Business-style assistants, long-context summaries and function/tool experiments.
models.install_note: Good free candidate for product/business users who need long context on capable machines.

models.label: Phi-4 Mini - compact premium-feel local
models.best_for: Higher-quality compact local assistant, multilingual, reasoning and math.
models.install_note: Bigger download, but a strong free local candidate on capable machines.

models.label: CodeGemma 2B - code assistant
models.best_for: Local coding help, code completion experiments and developer onboarding.
models.install_note: Use for code-focused local tests; verify fit before production coding workflows.

models.label: Qwen3 1.7B - stronger tiny reasoning local
models.best_for: Reasoning, multilingual chat and agent-style workflows on laptops, desktops and stronger Pi/edge devices.
models.install_note: Good upgrade from Qwen3 0.6B when the user wants better quality but still low local cost.

models.label: Qwen3 4B - quality/value local
models.best_for: Better local reasoning, coding-adjacent prompts and multilingual assistants on capable machines.
models.install_note: Use when the device has more RAM and the user wants a stronger free local default.

models.label: Qwen2.5 Coder 0.5B - tiny code local
models.best_for: Very small local coding demos, syntax help and developer onboarding on weak machines.
models.install_note: Tiny coding specialist. Good for proving the developer route before larger downloads.

models.label: Qwen2.5 Coder 1.5B - code local
models.best_for: Free local code explanation, refactoring prompts and repo assistant smoke tests.
models.install_note: Good default small code model when the user wants a useful developer assistant locally.

models.label: Qwen2.5 Coder 3B - stronger code local
models.best_for: More capable local coding, architecture notes and code-review style prompts.
models.install_note: Use on capable laptops/desktops when local coding quality matters more than smallest download.

models.label: Llama 3.2 3B - stronger local assistant
models.best_for: General local chat, summarization, private assistant workflows and better first-run quality.
models.install_note: Stronger than the 1B starter while still practical on many laptops/desktops.

models.label: Gemma 3 4B - capable local assistant
models.best_for: Higher-quality local assistant, multimodal-ready roadmap, summaries and product support.
models.install_note: Recommended when the user wants stronger answers and has enough RAM/storage.

models.label: Mistral 7B - practical local chat
models.best_for: Fast practical assistant behavior, summaries and general local chat on capable machines.
models.install_note: Use as a known practical baseline when the machine can handle a larger download.

models.label: Nomic Embed Text - local embedding index
models.best_for: Free local embeddings for future knowledge upload and document search.
models.install_note: Not a chat model. Install only after knowledge indexing is enabled.
